scope: Gives the explicit aggregation of the already frozen validation action-agreement criterion before seeing any new-package predictions. No change to fit, splits or native gate.
primary: For each validation map, take the signed difference in candidate and parent expert matches across occupied slots actionable in BOTH normal-entry emitted prefixes. Divide by this map's eligible slot count, then mean the differences across the 20 maps with equal weight. Positive is the registered offline continuation signal. Joint exact-match and role-specific effects are descriptive. Also show same statistic on 20 disjoint holdout maps without selection.
secondary: Run same analysis on public standalone network-only entry. A score in either replay test measures agreement on demonstrated states, not survival, real game points or wins.
